en: It looks like...that's everyone...

Oh...this everyone, huh?
There...a lot less of us now.
This is just half of what we started with...

Because we've allowed this game to continue.
We must stop it somehow—

But we can't stop nooooow!!!
We can't let the fun end!

C-Cut it out! I'm certain this trial will be
the last one!
Let's focus on surviving this class trial first.

Y-You're right... If we mess up here, 
our numbers will go down even quicker...
It'd just be the culprit left...

That might be okay. Maybe that's just
another way to stop the killing game.
If we all die, then the killing game would end.

Don't say stupid crap like that!
It's pointless if we all die!

Well...we don't have to worry. We've got 
the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Detective<CLT=cltNORMAL> on our side.

Yeah, it's time for the detective to shine.
Shuichi, please keep up the good work.
Y-Yeah... I'll do my best.

<CLT=cltMIND>Yes...I have to keep it together.
This is the only time my talent can shine.

<CLT=cltMIND>I'm not just saving my life...
everyone's life is on the line.

<CLT=cltMIND>If I can't find the truth here,
everyone will be sacrificed...
<CLT=cltMIND>And I will never let that happen—
Hey, Shuichi. You're getting all tense.
Ah, what?

Didn't I tell you before?
Shuichi, don't carry the burden all—

And didn't *I* tell you before not to get
in the way, Kaito?
Huh? What's your problem?

We're all relying on Shuichi to carry our asses
through this class trial, okay?

You're like a parrot repeating the same lines
over and over. You're bothering him.

I think that's the most annoying thing you
can do to Shuichi, y'know that?

Wh-What do you mean?
I'm not—
Kokichi...you're annoying.

Whoa...killer girl's glaring at me...
I was only kidding around...

<CLT=cltMIND>Maki's glare seemed to do the trick,
as Kokichi turned around, dejected.

Finally, that pest is gone.
Thanks, Maki Roll.

Just suck it up, Kaito. Now's not the time
to be bickering with each other.
Ah, my bad. Sorry.
...Kaito, I'm okay.
Hm?

I know what you want to say, Kaito.
You don't have to worry.

I see... In that case, I'll believe in you 
and won't say anything else.

But if you have any problems, let me know. 
I'll help you. I'm here for you, bro.
...Thank you, Kaito.
I'll believe in you and won't say anything else.

But if you have any problems, let me know. 
I'll help you. I'm here for you, bro.

Gonta not really understand what happen...
But...Gonta try real hard to be useful this time.

You must have it rough, Shuichi. That
obnoxious guy is always bothering you...

If you ever need my help, call me! I'll shut
him up, so he never gets in your way!

Miu certainly wasn't perfect...but that doesn't
mean she deserved to be killed.

No one deserves what happened to her...
Not a single person.

We'll be depending on you this time, too,
Mr. <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Detective<CLT=cltNORMAL>!

...You didn't forget, right?
Remember <CLT=cltSTRONG>who<CLT=cltNORMAL> you are.
Make sure you never forget that.

This time...will really be the end.
If not...
Yes
No
Are you unsure of something?
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Would you like to leave?

<CLT=cltMIND>I have to keep myself together!
Now's the time to use my talent!
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>*rumble rumble rumble!*
Alright, let's go...
Y-Yeah!
<CLT=cltMIND>The eight of us got into the elevator.
<CLT=cltMIND>The door shut behind us.

<CLT=cltMIND>And like all those times before,
we descended.
<CLT=cltMIND>It was dead quiet.

<CLT=cltMIND>The only sound I could hear was the
beating of my heart in my ears.
<CLT=cltMIND>My body was trembling...

<CLT=cltMIND>The more I tried to control it,
the worse it got...

<CLT=cltMIND>There's no way to get used to it, really.
The fear of death.

<CLT=cltMIND>We were all fighting it, 
trying to be courageous.

<CLT=cltMIND>We all felt as though we were going
to our own execution.
<CLT=cltMIND>No, not an execution.
<CLT=cltMIND>A test of our will to survive!
